blocks.content: The plain-Node verification harness: picks the first reachable backend (preferring coder/qwen/llama/granite models), plants a scratch project with notes.txt containing 'The secret word is: ANVIL-7', and asks the agent to find it and write answer.txt. Pass requires the file to contain ANVIL-7 with stopReason end_turn. It exercises discovery, tool use, file write, and the multi-step loop with zero Electron involvement.

The 3B test model occasionally ignores instructions on a given seed. The in-app E2E wraps turns with retry nudges; smoke deliberately stays retry-free so it remains a raw model-quality signal — one failed smoke against a passing E2E is a model roll, not a regression.
Backend auto-pick → scratch project → runAgentTurn → file assertion → PASS/FAIL exit code.
